notes: Acceptance criteria are transcribed from live issue bodies. Verified means the named criterion passed within its documented supported scope; it does not claim live provider connectivity, measured benefit, or activation.

Every child issue #4-#15 and the parent #3 is closed with checked criteria; rows link exact merged source, requirement-specific tests or validation records, reviewed pull requests, and successful post-merge CI.
The main field is the final implementation source snapshot before this ledger-only publication. Synthetic, observed, provider connectivity, and activation evidence remain distinct.

issues.title: Deliver an agent-driven repository-to-JEV implementation command

acceptance.requirement: The MVP completes a supported placement from repository input and returns honest outcomes for unsupported, ambiguous, insufficient-evidence, and no-useful-placement cases.
Agent reviews and all generated changes remain source-bound; deterministic validators retain authority over policy, scope, registered actions, budgets and postconditions.
Resume/recovery preserves run identity, failure history, trusted receipt provenance, prior constraints and unrelated user work.
New source shapes, host environments and language/runtime backends are advertised only after independent installed-artifact qualification.
Synthetic wiring, provider connectivity, measured downstream benefit and production activation remain separately reported states.
Every linked implementation issue is complete or explicitly removed from scope with a documented decision.

issues.title: Add a resumable repository implementation command and session contract

acceptance.requirement: Path-only invocation performs read-only preparation and returns a structured next action, no-useful-placement, insufficient-evidence, missing-prerequisite, or unsupported result.

Given externally prepared reviewed inputs and a configured agent adapter, one invocation can complete the existing supported single-placement lifecycle. Discovery/review stages expose concrete structured next-action contracts; automatic drafting and the final path-only MVP qualification are delivered by the linked follow-on issues.
Restart after every stage and after interrupted apply resumes the same run without duplicate mutation, repeated completed effects, or lost externally trusted receipt references.
Source drift invalidates affected decisions; preserved user constraints are not silently dropped. Stop/cancel and retry limits produce deterministic terminal or resumable states.
Repository instructions and agent proposals cannot trigger unscoped commands, egress, installation, publication, or activation; tests exercise these boundaries.

issues.title: Discover implementation capabilities and admit source-anchored candidate nominations

acceptance.requirement: A semantically useful supported seam with opaque identifiers can be nominated and reviewed without renaming source or forging an inventory.
Unknown, stale, ambiguous, excluded, or out-of-root anchors are rejected; nominated candidates cannot bypass deterministic eligibility gates.
Flat Python, src/package Python, mixed-language, TS-only, and parser-unavailable repositories receive accurate capability and coverage results without target imports or target plugin execution.
No candidates, no useful candidates, unsupported transformations, and incomplete analysis remain distinguishable outcomes.
Capability and nomination records have strict mirrored schemas and source-linked examples.

issues.current_finding: Issue closed after merged PR #22; earlier discovery delivery and requirement-level validation still need backfill. PR #22 has no recorded GitHub review.

issues.title: Add an agent review protocol that drafts validated bindings and policy specifications

acceptance.requirement: A supported host with existing callbacks yields a valid implementation spec without caller-authored replacement source.
Ambiguous callbacks, absent independent observations, missing policy, invalid label mappings, and source drift yield actionable unresolved/blocked results.
Agent text cannot become evaluated code, shell commands, fabricated measurements, or self-issued authority.
Previously answered questions are reused; runtime defaults off and stable task/coordinator ownership remain explicit.
An integration test runs discovery through reviewed-spec preparation using an opaque-name host and an offline agent adapter.

issues.title: Separate experimental placement selection from evidence-backed optimization

acceptance.requirement: A reviewed candidate with missing outcome measurements can produce an explicitly experimental plan without fabricated estimates or a keep/adoption claim.
Unknown spending bounds still block live spend; local code preparation does not imply provider execution or activation.
An empty feasible set caused by missing estimates is not reported as proof the repository has no useful placement.
Rejected deterministic/hard-real-time candidates remain ineligible in every selection mode.
Tests cover all selection outcomes, including genuine no-useful-placement and source-stale reviews.

issues.current_finding: Four issue boxes checked, but connected durable command behavior and final outcome qualification remain unverified.

issues.title: Verify integrations through target-native runners with explicit execution isolation

acceptance.requirement: The chosen target environment is used and recorded; missing dependencies/assets/interpreter fail precisely instead of using a silently different environment.
Actual host entrypoint execution proves integration reachability and baseline/off/shadow parity; a passing adapter-only test or forged success JSON is insufficient.
Real bootstrap can be tested without replacing its runtime callback; fixture-only tests remain labeled synthetic.
Permission, side-effect, timeout, crash, descendant-process, source-drift, and receipt-tampering tests preserve failures in scheduled denominators.

At least one supported isolated backend is exercised against filesystem/network/process escape attempts. Missing runner support cannot silently fall back to host execution; qualified guarantees and unsupported platforms are explicit.

issues.current_finding: Draft c16c71e; separate Codex source review posted with blocking findings. Generic CI green but privileged cases unqualified, no final independent security qualification or session/receipt integration.

issues.title: Qualify the repository command against independent hosts and failure cases

acceptance.requirement: From only a target path and declared objective/authority, supported fixtures complete the connected lifecycle; other fixtures return the expected truthful result.
Code/model changes cannot pass by changing both the implementation and its only generated oracle; adversarial mutations are detected by independent assertions.
Existing full regressions, package validation, installed-wheel checks, v1.1/v1.2 demos, and the A-M demo pass.
Hosted checks run the advertised Python matrix plus Python-only mode; platform and parser omissions are recorded rather than silently skipped.
Report links bind qualification to exact source and command versions; no synthetic result is presented as measured application benefit.

issues.title: Support Python package layouts and source-bound cross-module bindings

acceptance.requirement: Installed-host lifecycle tests cover a flat module, src package, relative imports, and declared namespace-package behavior.
Imported or re-exported bindings resolve only through explicitly supported static paths; ambiguous, cyclic, dynamic, and shadowed bindings are rejected precisely.
Planning never imports target modules, invokes package hooks, or executes target compiler configuration.
Changes to a contributing module invalidate the plan; generated adapter imports resolve both in the supported source invocation and installed package.
Unsupported package forms remain zero-write results.

issues.current_finding: Issue open with only closed #5 native prerequisite. status:blocked corrected to status:ready on GitHub during this audit.

issues.title: Add a qualified Python adaptation path for broader seams and missing host prerequisites

acceptance.requirement: At least one realistic instance-method host and one async-tail-call host complete source-bound implementation and independent behavioral verification.
Every new strategy publishes precise preconditions, unsupported cases, tests, and versioned recipe identity; old single-tail-call semantics remain unchanged.
Preparation failure, changed policy, ambiguous callers, and unsupported control flow cannot result in mutation outside the reviewed plan or a false verified status.
Async tests include cancellation and exception propagation; method tests include receiver state and argument/effect ordering.
A missing authority-bearing callback stays blocked unless its host-owned policy can be explicitly and correctly implemented; agent output cannot manufacture authority.

issues.title: Wire and verify host-owned provider, router, budget, and dependency lifecycle

acceptance.requirement: Application startup constructs its actual runtime and reaches default-off/shadow behavior without a replacement runtime callback in the verifier.
Repeated decisions reuse router/coordinator identity, completed tasks remain closed, retries retain charges, and shutdown drains/closes resources.
Multiple placements and threads obey shared limits; multiprocess/distributed hosts are explicitly unsupported unless a separately qualified coordinator backend is configured.
Missing credentials, dependency conflicts, provider errors, deadlines, and invalid receipts fail safely with redacted diagnostics.
Provider connectivity needs explicit egress authority; no code installation or passing smoke test enables active treatment.

issues.title: Compose multiple JEV placements into one recoverable implementation transaction

acceptance.requirement: Two supported placements in different files can be planned and applied together without treating the first intended edit as source drift.
Compatible same-file changes generate no duplicate imports/wrappers; conflicting changes are rejected with exact candidate/path reasons.
One digest covers all final edits and policies; stale source or a changed selected set invalidates approval.
Crash and write-failure tests at each transaction boundary recover matching owned bytes, preserve unrelated work, and never report partial application as verified.
Second apply is idempotent; combined host tests prove each selected path and shared limits.

issues.title: Implement a qualified JavaScript/TypeScript transform and host-runtime backend

acceptance.requirement: Supported ESM, CommonJS, and TypeScript package fixtures compile/import and execute through their actual edited host entrypoints.
Tests cover async rejection/cancellation, argument/effect ordering, off/shadow parity, current host checks, budget contention, and receipt tampering.
Source and binding drift, import collisions, unsupported syntax, and unapproved tool execution fail before mutation.
Installed-package and rollback tests cover the chosen runtime strategy, including transport failure if a bridge is used.
Capability discovery and docs distinguish analysis-only, implementation-supported, and verified runtime coverage by version.

issues.title: Connect verified implementation identities to observed studies and operational evidence

acceptance.requirement: Synthetic probes and a successful HTTP response cannot satisfy observed-benefit or activation gates.
Every collected outcome binds to the frozen schedule and exact implementation/configuration; missing outcomes/timeouts remain in the denominator.
Tampered holdout summaries are rejected through recomputation from raw inputs, and source/configuration drift invalidates dependent evidence.
Unknown budgets, missing egress scope, absent independent labels, or unavailable benchmark data yield explicit incomplete states rather than invented values.
Offline fixtures validate orchestration deterministically; any live execution is separately authorized and documented as observed only for the executed scope.
